about: Upstream's English strings in PassBundle's words, by message key, applied by brand/apply.mjs after branding; {brand} is the product's name from brand.json. One word, folder, for every place an item lives: Personal and its folders, and each organization's shared folders (upstream's collections); the word vault stays only where it means the whole encrypted store, listed in kept with why. See DESIGN.md, 'Folders and permissions'. 'all' applies to every app's English strings that have the key; 'web' and 'browser' only to that app's. A key no app has fails the brand step, so upstream renames are noticed.
